scores.tell: Hero fills the card with a tight, even margin and sits centered on a plain surface and backdrop. Close to the real cards. The slight empty band at the bottom is the only tell.
Map stack is large and centered with a clear first read on a flat backdrop. It is a little tightly packed and symmetric, but that matches the real cards.
The hat is big, tilted, nearly touches the side edges, and sits on a rays background. Reads like the real whistle and glove cards. None.
Centered, symmetric candelabra at roughly 60% width with wide empty purple sides. It is a little small and static next to the real cards, which fill the frame more.
The pumpkin fills the width and is cropped close to the edges, with the table at the bottom. It matches the real cards. The table takes up a lot of the lower third.

The topiary sits in a busy full scene with a bench, lamp, path and hedges all competing for attention. The hero is not isolated, so the card reads as a scene, not an object card. Only the real swing card resembles it.
The spotlight is large and diagonal, cut off by the truss at the top and left. It fills the frame on a clean gradient. Very close to the real cards.
The chair is small and sits lopsided on a large beige slab that takes up the bottom third. It leaves much empty space, and the hero is thin and spindly at thumbnail size.
The cap is large, tilted, and fills the frame well. The busy wood wall and floor behind it compete with it, and the cap's white top blends into the wall highlight.
The rover is mid-sized and sits centered on a ground band, with many small parts and pebbles. The first read is slower, and the empty sky above the hero feels less tight than the real cards.
